dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures visible along the mid-to-posterior dorsal region, characterized by jagged, high-contrast light-intensity perimeters with a distinct gradient transition to darker interior fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity light-pixel clusters located primarily in the anterior and mid-sections, interspersed between larger annuli and exhibiting no internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent posterior macro-annuli form a distorted quadrilateral elongated along the dorsal-ventral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast vertical striations along the distal edge of the dorsal flipper.
